concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-control-panel-vault-overview]] - Vault purpose, encrypted tokenized payment-method storage, high-level record administration, Control Panel exports, CVV non-retention and the recurring-statement-indicator caveat, with create, update and verification procedures left to dedicated pages
warnings: Keep this as an overview route; do not import procedural, permission, eligibility or outcome facts from the unread Create New Customers, Update Customer Information or Card Verification pages.
Do not broaden the linked PCI wording into a general compliance guarantee, and preserve the page's explicit never-store-CVV warning.
Preserve that the recurring ecommerce indicator can appear on a statement without establishing enrollment in future recurring payments.
Preserve the 40,000-row export limit and the separate warning that spreadsheet software may omit rows when opening the download.
Treat linked and adjacent raw pages as navigation only unless they are separately read in full.
